grh_b2cdd797ac521f8181d9.title: An Old Moorish Custom
paragraphs: In North Africa, Harry falls for De Rouge, granddaughter of wealthy Armand Deluge, while rumors of a Barbary-pirate treasure attract a gang led by Mario and the mysterious El Sikina. Harry and De Rouge are captured and forced to lead the gang to a coastal cave containing old chests and gold dust. The criminals celebrate with wine stored beside the treasure, only to collapse because Deluge had deliberately poisoned it for anyone who came looting in his absence. Harry saves De Rouge and escapes, but the romance ends with her goodbye rather than the fortune he imagined.
